name: Blinn-Phong Shading in Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that uses ray marching with Blinn-Phong lighting to render 3D volumes, specifically implemented in the `ossium` project for WebGPU.
summary: Blinn-Phong Shading in Volume Rendering applies the Blinn-Phong lighting model to volume data during ray marching, using per-sample normals to provide surface-like shading cues that enhance depth perception and material appearance.
